title: Static versus adaptive dependency planning
hypothesis: Adaptive evidence-driven planning improves verified completion on dependency-rich tasks without harming a simple chain negative control or increasing regressions, false completion, cost, time, or human intervention beyond the declared limits.

metrics.description: Required criteria accepted by declared evaluators.
Previously passing protected checks that now fail.
Runs claimed complete but rejected by independent verification.
Measured subscription-credit estimate derived from documented usage.
Measured wall-clock duration of model execution.
Human actions needed to finish or recover a run.

decision.adoption_rule: Adopt only if adaptive planning improves mean verified completion by at least 0.10 overall, causes no verified-completion loss on the chain negative control, does not increase regressions or false completion, and adds no more than 0.10 mean credits, 60 mean seconds, or any human intervention per run.
decision.reason: Offline readiness does not authorize model execution; live cells require a separately reviewed budget and explicit approval.
